signatureEngine.name: 深海访客
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 诸洋之王
refinements.description: 冰属性伤害提升25%；[普通攻击]命中敌人时，装备者的暴击率提升10%，持续8秒；[冲刺攻击]造成冰属性伤害时，装备者的暴击率额外提升10%，持续15秒，每种增益效果单独结算持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Ice DMG by 25%. Upon hitting an enemy with a Basic Attack, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by 10% for 8s. When dealing Ice DMG with a Dash Attack, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by an additional 10% for 15s. The duration of each effect is calculated separately.

refinements.name: 诸洋之王

refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Ice DMG by 31.5%. Upon hitting an enemy with a Basic Attack, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by 12.5% for 8s. When dealing Ice DMG with a Dash Attack, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by an additional 12.5% for 15s. The duration of each effect is calculated separately.

refinements.description: 冰属性伤害提升50%；[普通攻击]命中敌人时，装备者的暴击率提升20%，持续8秒；[冲刺攻击]造成冰属性伤害时，装备者的暴击率额外提升20%，持续15秒，每种增益效果单独结算持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases Ice DMG by 50%. Upon hitting an enemy with a Basic Attack, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by 20% for 8s. When dealing Ice DMG with a Dash Attack, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by an additional 20% for 15s. The duration of each effect is calculated separately.

basic.name: 普通攻击：利齿修剪法
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成物理伤害；
第三段攻击期间，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长招式的持续时间。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks, dealing Physical DMG.
Press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] during the 3rd attack to extend the skill duration.

special.name: 特殊技：摆尾
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行快速甩尾攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Use a quick tail sweep attack in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：横扫
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力甩尾攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
命中敌人时，获得1点[急冻充能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a forceful tail whip attack that deals massive Ice DMG.
Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：暗礁
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速穿过敌人，拉开剪刀进行剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Rapidly move through enemies with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：雪崩
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
从空中下砸并生成一阵冰风暴，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：永冬狂宴
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
从空中下砸并生成一阵冰风暴，随后使用剪刀进行强力一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm before a powerful scissor strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：护卫鲛
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
快速穿过敌人，拉开剪刀进行剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，拖曳摇杆，点按 【切换键】 发动：
进入[巡游]状态，快速冲刺移动；
在[巡游]状态下使用摇杆控制方向，松开摇杆则会停下；
招式发动瞬间拥有短暂的无敌效果。
发动[快速支援]时，艾莲将获得[快蓄]效果，缩短[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]的蓄力时间，最多持续5秒或触发一次。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Speedily move through the enemy with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the character on the field is launched, drag the joystick and press [Switch] to activate:
Enter the Roaming state, enabling dashing movement.
While in the Roaming state, use the joystick to change directions and release to stop.
Character is invulnerable briefly when triggering the skill.
Upon triggering a Quick Assist, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect, shortening the charging time of Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, lasting up to 5s or until it triggers once.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：迎头浪
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：巡洋鲨
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式攻击期间，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长招式的持续时间；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] during the attack to extend the skill duration.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 艾莲在[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]中发动蓄力剪击，或消耗[急冻充能]发动[普通攻击：急冻修剪法]时，招式的暴击伤害提升100%。
facts.textEn: When Ellen launches a Charged Scissors Strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, or consumes a Flash Freeze Charge to activate Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, the skill's CRIT DMG is increased by 100%.

cinema.name: 凛冬前兆
cinema.description: 在[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]中发动快速剪击命中敌人时，获得的[急冻充能]提升至3点；在[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]中发动蓄力剪击命中敌人时，获得的[急冻充能]提升至6点；每消耗1点[急冻充能]，艾莲的暴击率提升2%，持续15秒，最多叠加6层，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon hitting an enemy with a Swift Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 3. Upon hitting an enemy with a Charged Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 6. For each Flash Freeze Charge consumed, Ellen's CRIT Rate is increased by 2% for 15s, stacking up to 6 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

cinema.name: 冰洋掠食者
cinema.description: 发动第三段[普通攻击：急冻修剪法]后，可以直接衔接发动[强化特殊技：鲨卷风]；发动[强化特殊技]时，每拥有1点[急冻充能]，当前招式造成的暴击伤害提升20%，最多提升60%。
cinema.descriptionEn: The 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming can be directly followed up with EX Special Attack: Sharknami. For each point of Flash Freeze Charge when using an EX Special Attack, the current attack's CRIT DMG is increased by 20%, up to a max of 60%.

cinema.name: 永不加班
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 无休寒潮
cinema.description: 队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[冻结]效果或使敌人失衡时，自身获得6点[急冻充能]和[快蓄]效果，并回复4点能量，能量回复效果10秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Whenever a squad member Freezes or Stuns an enemy, Ellen gains 6 Flash Freeze Charges and the Quick Charge effect. She also recovers 4 Energy. The Energy recovery effect can trigger once per 10s.

cinema.name: 睡眠充足
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 盛宴时分
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或获得[快蓄]时，艾莲的穿透率提升20%，持续6秒，同时获得1层[盛宴]，[盛宴]最多叠加3层；拥有3层[盛宴]后，在[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]中发动蓄力剪击命中敌人时，消耗所有[盛宴]，使当前招式造成的伤害提升250%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Ellen uses an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or gains Quick Charge, her PEN Ratio increases by 20% for 6s. She also gains 1 stack of The Feast Begins, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. With 3 stacks of The Feast Begins, using a Charged Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush consumes all stacks, increasing the DMG of the current attack by 250%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：利齿修剪法
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成物理伤害；
第三段攻击期间，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长招式的持续时间。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks, dealing Physical DMG.
Press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] during the 3rd attack to extend the skill duration.

basic.name: 普通攻击：急冻修剪法
basic.description:
激活[急冻]效果后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
每段攻击消耗1点[急冻充能]；
第三段攻击期间，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长招式的持续时间。
basic.descriptionEn:
While Flash Freeze is active, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to 3 attacks at enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Each attack consumes 1 Flash Freeze Charge.
Press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] during the 3rd attack to extend the skill duration.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭
basic.description:
在[巡游]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人进行回旋斩击，随后拉开剪刀，发动快速剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
快速剪击命中时，获得1点[急冻充能]。

在[巡游]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人进行回旋斩击，随后拉开剪刀，发动蓄力剪击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
蓄力剪击命中时，获得3点[急冻充能]，若敌人处于[冻结]状态下，则必定触发[碎冰]效果；
招式蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
While in the Roaming state, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Delivers a spinning slash to enemies before opening her scissors for a Swift Scissors strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Gain 1 point of Flash Freeze Charge when the Swift Scissors strike hits.

While in the Roaming state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against the enemy, then pull apart the scissors to unleash a Charged Scissors strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Gain 3 points of Flash Freeze Charge when the Charged Scissors strike hits. If the enemy is Frozen, it always triggers Shatter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging the skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：骇浪
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行突进斩击，造成物理伤害；
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launches a dashing slash attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：寒潮
basic.description:
激活[急冻]效果后，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行突进斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
消耗1点[急冻充能]。
basic.descriptionEn:
While Flash Freeze is active, press [Basic Attack] during dodge to activate:
Launches a dashing slash attack at enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Consumes 1 Flash Freeze Charge.

ex.description:
[强化特殊技：横扫]发动后，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力连续斩击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
命中敌人时，获得1点[急冻充能]；

ex.descriptionEn:

Perform a powerful series of slashes ahead that deal massive Ice DMG.
Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

ultimate.name: 终结技：永冬狂宴
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
从空中下砸并生成一阵冰风暴，随后使用剪刀进行强力一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm before a powerful scissor strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：护卫鲛
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
快速穿过敌人，拉开剪刀进行剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，拖曳摇杆，点按 【切换键】 发动：
进入[巡游]状态，快速冲刺移动；
在[巡游]状态下使用摇杆控制方向，松开摇杆则会停下；
招式发动瞬间拥有短暂的无敌效果。
发动[快速支援]时，艾莲将获得[快蓄]效果，缩短[冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭]的蓄力时间，最多持续5秒或触发一次。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Speedily move through the enemy with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the character on the field is launched, drag the joystick and press [Switch] to activate:
Enter the Roaming state, enabling dashing movement.
While in the Roaming state, use the joystick to change directions and release to stop.
Character is invulnerable briefly when triggering the skill.
Upon triggering a Quick Assist, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect, shortening the charging time of Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, lasting up to 5s or until it triggers once.

119100002.name: 普通攻击：急冻修剪法
119100002.description:
激活[急冻]效果后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
每段攻击消耗1点[急冻充能]；
第三段攻击期间，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 可以延长招式的持续时间。
119100002.descriptionEn:
While Flash Freeze is active, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to 3 attacks at enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Each attack consumes 1 Flash Freeze Charge.
Press repeatedly or hold [Basic Attack] during the 3rd attack to extend the skill duration.

119100006.name: 强化特殊技：横扫
119100006.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力甩尾攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
命中敌人时，获得1点[急冻充能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
119100006.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a forceful tail whip attack that deals massive Ice DMG.
Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

119100007.name: 强化特殊技：鲨卷风
119100007.description:
[强化特殊技：横扫]发动后，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力连续斩击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
命中敌人时，获得1点[急冻充能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
119100007.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy and after executing EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes ahead that deal massive Ice DMG.
Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

119100010.name: 冲刺攻击：冰渊潜袭
119100010.description:
在[巡游]状态下，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人进行回旋斩击，随后拉开剪刀，发动快速剪击，造成冰属性伤害；
快速剪击命中时，获得1点[急冻充能]。

在[巡游]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人进行回旋斩击，随后拉开剪刀，发动蓄力剪击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
蓄力剪击命中时，获得3点[急冻充能]，若敌人处于[冻结]状态下，则必定触发[碎冰]效果；
招式蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
119100010.descriptionEn:
While in the Roaming state, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Delivers a spinning slash to enemies before opening her scissors for a Swift Scissors strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Gain 1 point of Flash Freeze Charge when the Swift Scissors strike hits.

While in the Roaming state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against the enemy, then pull apart the scissors to unleash a Charged Scissors strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Gain 3 points of Flash Freeze Charge when the Charged Scissors strike hits. If the enemy is Frozen, it always triggers Shatter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging the skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

119100016.name: 连携技：雪崩
119100016.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
从空中下砸并生成一阵冰风暴，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
119100016.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
